main_comparison: Single-run R6/R1-R3 skill screening followed by matched three-run H0 versus final-skill confirmation on one fixed IronKV problem.
correctness_notes: The timed-out seed with missing terminal usage is marked invalid and has no token-height encoding.
Every screening skill has n=1 and is labeled as single-run evidence.
H0 and final confirmation each show all three verifier-safe run values.
The final favorable mean delta is explicitly labeled inconclusive because it is smaller than the H0 range.
review_note: Visual inspection found legend/value and mean/point overlaps. The legend was moved below the screening panel, invalid-run text was shortened, repeated-run labels were moved above the observed maxima, and the final render was re-inspected.
